notes.title: Gray Patch 14.08
notes.content: We have addressed some more of your feedback with the new patch. We have added UI Overlays to interactible items, and increased the interaction distance, making them slightly easier to find

notes.title: Patch notes 24.11
notes.content: Some people had experienced an issue with teleportation not working correctly near the last level. Apologies for this. The issue has now been rectified

notes.title: Patch notes 23.11
notes.content:
Have heard your feedback, and taken it on board. Listed are the main changes of the patch:

More health and o2 pickups on all levels,

Lower o2 depletion rate. The characters full tank now lasts 20 minutes before it is empty,

Issues where you can clip out of the level and into the void outside,

Health and o2 regeneration in the final levels


Thank you very much. Please do get in contact with any further issues.

Ben
